hypotheses.binder: (hTs : ∀ a, (plusWeylGradient g c e a)ᵀ = plusWeylGradient g c e a)
hypotheses.justification: Symmetry of the actual plus-Weyl gradient blocks holds for every SmoothMetric, frame and point, without any Einstein/Ricci assumption. In CurvatureTensors02.lean, `weylGradient_constraints_of_ricci_parallel` proves the symmetric part (`hsym`) using only `frame_normalizedWeyl_derivative_symmetries g c e` (line 2500). That lemma has no hypotheses beyond the standard manifold variables and gives FirstSkew, LastSkew and PairSymmetric for each derivative slice. Its Ricci hypothesis is used only for the trace part. `hsym` combines this with `AlgebraicCurvature.curvaturePairing_symmetric` (WeylEstimates01.lean) and `curvatureBlock_symmetric` (WeylGeometry.lean: a pair-symmetric R gives `(curvatureBlock R Q)ᵀ = curvatureBlock R Q`). Since `plusWeylGradient g c e i` unfolds to `gradientBlock T quaternionMatrix i`, which is a `curvatureBlock`, the same chain gives `∀ a, (plusWeylGradient g c e a)ᵀ = plusWeylGradient g c e a` unconditionally. The proof without hTs derives it this way and then applies `integral_normalDerivative_squareNorm_exact h _ _ hTs hTt` as before. By contrast, hTt is genuinely needed: the library only proves tracelessness from `RicciThree g`.
